title: Les Misérables: Macron's 'sense of detachment' amid rising living costs and youth 'fears for future'
description: France’s escalating protest movement is exposing a widening disconnect between political leadership and public frustration, while raising questions about the country’s long tradition of social unrest. Chris Reynolds, Professor of French and European Studies at Nottingham Trent University, argues that President Emmanuel Macron’s latest address was characterised by a troubling “sense of detachment,” offering little to resolve the structural grievan

title: Drone attack near southern Sudan market kills scores
description: At least 80 people were killed in a drone strike near a market in Sudan’s southern West Kordofan state, a medical source and a witness said Monday. The strike in the town of Al-Dibab on Sunday evening is among the deadliest single attacks since war erupted between Sudan’s army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces in 2023.

title: France: Police and protesters clash violently over the weekend
description: Hundreds of thousands took to the streets to protest higher living costs and the poor conditions in schools and other public services in France over the weekend. Police arrested nearly 2,400 people after violent groups clashed with officers and looted shops.The widespread unrest deepens political uncertainty in France as it prepares for elections in six months.

title: State of emergency could be declared to help stem protests, French PM says
description: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has warned that a state of emergency could be imposed "if needed" as authorities struggle to contain violent protests, which have affected thousands of businesses, sweeping parts of the country. The violence comes months before France’s presidential election, raising concerns over public security and political stability.

title: Italy hit by violent cost-of-living protests, mostly minors arrested
description: Youths and police clashed for a second consecutive day on Sunday in Milan, where at least 200 people were arrested during protests over the cost of living. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called a security meeting for Monday to address the violence, which evoked scenes of chaos and looting in Paris. FRANCE 24's Seema Gupta reports from Rome, Italy.

title: Inflation squeezes households as Lebanon's economic crisis persists
description: Lebanon's economic crisis has dragged on since 2019. A re-igniting of Israel's war with Hezbollah derailed the weak recovery seen last year. The World Bank now forecasts that the Lebanese economy will shrink by 6.4 percent this year, with inflation expected to reach around 17.5 percent. A growing divide is visible everywhere: in households, in businesses and even in consumer habits. Our correspondents Serge Berberi and Renée Davis report.

title: Dozens killed after Houthi strike on military camp in Shabwa
description: Dozens of Yemenis are feared dead after a Houthi strike targeted a military camp in Yemen’s Shabwa governorate.

title: Russia’s Lavrov discusses US war and regional security during Tehran visit
description: GCC states have pressed Moscow to help halt Iranian attacks and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

title: At least 18 killed in Houthi attack on military camp in Yemen’s Shabwa
description: Houthis launch ballistic missiles at camp in southern governorate during training exercise, govt forces spokesman says.

title: Al Jazeera investigation challenges Israeli account of Heidi Levine attack
description: Analysis of map coordinates and timelines raises doubts over official Israeli accounts of West Bank settler pogrom.

title: On Iran, Israel’s opposition is even more hawkish than Netanyahu
description: In rest of the world, the Israeli PM is often blamed for the Iran war. His opponents say he hasnt been tough enough.

title: Iran support for Houthis probed as Yemen war re-erupts and Saudi cities hit
description: There have been new reports of Iranian support for the Houthis in Yemen amid a wave of attacks on Saudi cities.

title: PSG vs Barcelona match will not be postponed despite protests: French PM
description: Barcelona travel to Paris for the Champions League match at the Parc des Princes on Tuesday at 19:00 GMT.

title: Doctors describe hospitals shattered by Israel’s genocide in Gaza
description: Doctors who volunteered in Gaza have described working during Israel’s genocidal war on the strip.

title: For Israelis and Jews in the U.A.E., an Eroding Sense of Security
description: The Emirates’ reputation as a haven was shaken by what the authorities said was a plot last month aimed at crashing a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv.

title: Will Trump’s Endorsement of Netanyahu Fire Up His Campaign or Fizzle?
description: President Trump said Benjamin Netanyahu was a “Great Warrior,” as he faces a tough re-election bid for prime minister. But the Trump brand is not what it once was in Israel, analysts say.
